name: Card Tabs
description: Tabs whose panels are a stack of cards, where choosing a tab brings its card to the front.

props.name: tabs
props.type: { value: string; title: ReactNode; content: ReactNode }[]
props.description: One entry per tab. The content becomes a card in the stack; give it its own height and background.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tab in front at first (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when another tab is chosen.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the tab list for assistive technology.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: Whether arrow keys bring a card forward straight away, or only move focus until Enter or Space.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, e.g. a max width. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Tabs.
